description: The FIC performs forensic DNA analysis for more than 500 law enforcement agencies, developing DNA profiles from biological evidence to use for comparison purposes, such as to generate investigative leads, identify perpetrators, and exonerate the innocent. Should a suitable DNA profile be developed from crime scene evidence, it may be entered into the Combined DNA Index System (CODIS), which is administered by the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) for searching at the local, state, and/or national levels.
